modularity_definition: igraph unweighted undirected modularity, resolution=1, original simple graph

parameters.note: Number of communities is chosen automatically by greedy modularity optimisation.

preprocessing.policy: Undirected simple graph; self-loops and duplicate (incl. reversed) edges dropped; no nodes removed; whole graph (all components) used.

target_label_note: country_target_id is the dataset's integer country-derived class; the README does not give the id->country mapping.
